fixed kicking players from lobby

fixed map editor not working online
fixed updating lobby settings online

removed random useless graphics settings

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.9.020
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I have been busy squashing bugs and polishing the gameplay experience in Sliced. Version 0.9.020 focuses on enhancing multiplayer synchronization and fixing various issues.

Multiplayer Improvements

Improved Animation Synchronization:  Multiplayer animations have received a major overhaul, leading to smoother and more synchronized actions between players online.  Movements and attacks should now be visually consistent for all players.
Projectile Synchronization: Projectiles are now correctly synchronized in multiplayer, fixing issues where they appeared differently for each player.
Weapon Recoil Visualization:  Weapon recoil is now properly displayed for all players in multiplayer, adding another layer of realism to online combat.
Charged Punch Online Functionality: The charged punch is now fully functional in multiplayer, delivering the intended powerful impact online.


Update now to v0.9.020 to experience these improvements! As always, your feedback is important, so let me know what you think. Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.9.013
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This update focuses primarily on enhancing the multiplayer experience and fixing bugs that have popped up since the last update. Version 0.9.013 delivers significant improvements to multiplayer synchronization and stability, making for a more enjoyable and reliable online experience.

Multiplayer Improvements

Significantly Improved Multiplayer Synchronization: I have put a lot of work into improving how players' actions and game states are synchronized in multiplayer matches. You should now see a dramatic reduction in desynchronization issues, resulting in smoother, more consistent online gameplay.
Improved Multiplayer Connection Stability:  This update includes optimizations to the networking layer, boosting connection stability and reducing the likelihood of dropped connections or other interruptions mid-match.


Bug Fixes

Match Restart Cleanup: Fixed issues that prevented resources from being cleaned up properly during match restarts. This change will improve performance and stability during extended play sessions.
Player Updates: Fixed a bug causing inconsistencies in player data updates, which sometimes led to discrepancies in displayed information.
Weapon Spawn Initialization: Addressed problems with weapon spawns not initializing correctly, especially in online games.
Lobby UI:  Made several fixes to the lobby user interface, ensuring player data displays correctly and state transitions are handled smoothly.
Weapon Pickup:  Squashed several bugs related to weapon pickup, making it more reliable and preventing situations where players couldn't pick up weapons or picked them up incorrectly.
Error Handling: Improved error handling and logging to facilitate quicker identification and resolution of any future issues.
Memory Management:  Further addressed issues where disposed objects were being accessed, which could lead to instability and crashes.  This builds on improvements from the previous update.


This update marks a significant stride toward the full 1.0 release.

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.9.000
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm super excited to share this major milestone update for Sliced! I've been working hard on improving performance and squashing bugs to make your gaming experience even better. Here's what's new:

Performance Enhancements

Optimized Frame Rates: Completely revamped the rendering system for smoother gameplay across all devices
Memory Usage: Significantly reduced memory footprint during extended gaming sessions
Network Optimization: Enhanced multiplayer connection stability and reduced latency
Quad Trees: Implemented quad tree data structures for optimized object detection and collision checking


Bug Fixes

Physics Engine: Resolved collision detection issues in high-speed scenarios
Animation System: Fixed character animation glitches during rapid movement changes
Match Restarts: Fixed various issues where match restarts weren't cleaning up properly
Memory Management: Resolved issues with disposed objects still being accessed, leading to better stability


Technical Improvements

Updated to the latest game engine version (Godot 4.4)
Upgraded to .NET 9 for improved performance and newer features

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.8.356
notes.content:
Sliced Game Update - Version 0.8.356
We are excited to announce the latest update for Sliced, now available for all players. This update focuses on enhancing your gameplay experience and brings multiplayer back online! Here's what's new:

Gameplay Adjustments:
Progression Container Pop-Up: We've disabled the progression container from always popping up after a match. This should provide a smoother, more uninterrupted gaming experience post-match.

Multiplayer Functionality: Great news - Multiplayer is back online! We've made the necessary improvements and are thrilled to welcome you back to our multiplayer arena. Jump back in and enjoy competing against others.

Please update your game to version 0.8.356 to enjoy these latest improvements. As always, we thank you for your support and feedback, which help us make Sliced better for everyone.

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.8.345
notes.content:

We're rolling out a minor update for Sliced that addresses an important audio issue. This update is now available for download, and here are the details:

We recommend all players to update to the latest version for the best gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Sliced Update - Version 0.8.330
notes.content:
Sliced Game Update - Version 0.8.330
We're excited to announce a new update for Sliced, which is now available for download. This update includes several important fixes and changes aimed at improving your gaming experience. Please see below for the details:

Bug Fixes:
Respawn Mechanics: Fixed an issue where players were unable to respawn properly in certain scenarios. Players should now experience seamless respawning during gameplay.

Throwable Weapons: Addressed a bug that caused throwable weapons to despawn immediately upon landing. Weapons will now remain in the game world post-impact as intended, enhancing combat dynamics and strategy.

Gameplay Adjustments:
Multiplayer Disabled Temporarily: We've temporarily disabled multiplayer functionalities to conduct necessary fixes and improvements. This decision was made to ensure the best possible gaming experience. We're working diligently to bring multiplayer back better than ever and will keep you updated on our progress.

Other:
Various minor tweaks and optimizations to enhance game stability and performance.
We appreciate your patience and support as we continue to refine and improve Sliced. Please continue to report any issues you encounter, and stay tuned for more updates!
